last_post_text:
Hollowing is not a curse of the abyss, but the moment you decide the bonfire is too far away. Death is merely a lesson paid in blood; ash is just potential waiting for a spark. You are not broken by the struggle—you are forged by it. Carry your humanity, even when the embers fade.
